name: Frappe Bench
postCreateCommand:
if [ "$FRAPPE_DEV_AGENTS" = 1 ]; then
  sudo chown "$(id -u):$(id -g)" /home/frappe/.config
  sudo chown -R "$(id -u):$(id -g)" "$CODEX_HOME" "$T3CODE_HOME" "$GH_CONFIG_DIR" "$GLAB_CONFIG_DIR"
  cd /workspace/development
  python installer.py --apps-json "$FRAPPE_APPS_JSON" --bench-name "$FRAPPE_BENCH_NAME" --site-name "$FRAPPE_SITE_NAME"
  cd "$FRAPPE_BENCH_NAME"
  uv pip freeze --python env/bin/python --exclude-editable > env/pre-commit-constraints.txt
  uv pip install --python env/bin/python --constraint env/pre-commit-constraints.txt pre-commit
  uv pip check --python env/bin/python
  sudo apt-get update
  sudo apt-get install --yes --no-install-recommends gh glab
  npm install --global @openai/codex t3
  t3 --version
  if [ -f /run/frappe-codex-auth.json ] && [ ! -e "$CODEX_HOME/auth.json" ]; then
    (umask 077; cp -n /run/frappe-codex-auth.json "$CODEX_HOME/auth.json")
  fi
else
  uv tool install pre-commit
fi
postStartCommand:
if [ "$FRAPPE_DEV_AGENTS" = 1 ]; then
  umask 077
  mkdir -p "$T3CODE_HOME/devcontainer"
  cd "/workspace/development/$FRAPPE_BENCH_NAME"
  . env/bin/activate
  nohup setsid --fork flock -n "$T3CODE_HOME/devcontainer/server.lock" bash -ec 'if [ -f /run/frappe-t3-settings.json ] && [ ! -e "$T3CODE_HOME/userdata/settings.json" ]; then
  mkdir -p "$T3CODE_HOME/userdata"
  python - /run/frappe-t3-settings.json <<'"'"'PYSEED'"'"' > "$T3CODE_HOME/userdata/.settings-seed.json"
import json
import sys

settings = json.load(open(sys.argv[1]))
if not isinstance(settings, dict):
    raise SystemExit("T3 settings must be a JSON object")
for key in list(settings):
    if (key.startswith("project") and key.endswith("Overrides")) or key in (
        "projectSettingsFolded", "worktreesDirectory", "previousWorktreesDirectories",
        "addProjectBaseDirectory", "environmentIcon", "deviceHosts", "easDeviceHosts",
        "sourceControlHosts", "usageLimitSources", "observability",
    ):
        del settings[key]
for instance in settings.get("providerInstances", {}).values():
    config = instance.get("config")
    if isinstance(config, dict):
        for key in ("binaryPath", "homePath", "shadowHomePath"):
            config.pop(key, None)
    if "environment" in instance:
        instance["environment"] = [
            variable for variable in instance["environment"]
            if not variable.get("sensitive") and not variable.get("valueRedacted")
        ]
json.dump(settings, sys.stdout, indent=2)
sys.stdout.write("\n")
PYSEED
  mv -n "$T3CODE_HOME/userdata/.settings-seed.json" "$T3CODE_HOME/userdata/settings.json"
fi
if ! project_result=$(t3 project add --base-dir "$T3CODE_HOME" --title "${COMPOSE_PROJECT_NAME:-$FRAPPE_BENCH_NAME}" "$PWD" 2>&1); then
  case "$project_result" in
    *ProjectAlreadyExistsError:*) ;;
    *) printf "%s\n" "$project_result" >&2; exit 1 ;;
  esac
fi
exec t3 serve --base-dir "$T3CODE_HOME" --host 0.0.0.0 --port 3773 --no-browser' >> "$T3CODE_HOME/devcontainer/server.log" 2>&1 < /dev/null &
  timeout 30 bash -c 'until [ -s "$T3CODE_HOME/userdata/server-runtime.json" ] && curl --noproxy "*" -fs -o /dev/null http://127.0.0.1:3773/; do sleep 1; done'
fi
